text:
alex: Heads up — compliance asked for a way to let auditors pull 7-day SIEM extracts for investigations without granting broad prod log read rights. Looking for an ephemeral export workflow + KMS unwrap pattern we can standardize.

maria: +1. We should avoid giving long-lived roles. Can we do a timeboxed export artifact that is encrypted with a separate export KMS key and has an access TTL?

jordan: We already have an "ephemeral-snapshots" S3 prefix and a short-lived pre-signed URL flow, but the sticky part is who can unwrap the KMS key to decrypt. Right now unwrapping requires the "log-decrypt" role which is broad.

karen: From compliance perspective: auditor access must be logged in audit trail and require a ticket + manager approval. Preferably no direct KMS key grants to external auditors. JIT (just-in-time) access with one-click approval is ideal.

alex: Proposed flow: 1) requester opens ticket (ticket ID appended to export metadata). 2) deployer runs export job that writes encrypted archive to ephemeral bucket with metadata ticket=ID, ttl=7d. 3) KMS unwrap capability implemented via a gateway Lambda that validates ticket+approval and returns a one-time decryption token. 4) pre-signed URL + one-time unwrap token provided to auditor.

maria: That could work. Implementation notes: - use an export-specific KMS key separate from production log keys - key policy denies direct IAM unwrapping except via the gateway role - gateway logs every unwrap to audit-log stream and writes a signed event to the ticketing system.

jordan: Operational concerns: how do we handle emergency incident requests where SOC needs faster access? Need a bypass that still records justification. Maybe allow "oncall" principal to request unwrap but require post-hoc review.

karen: Fine as long as the bypass is gated: MFA + manager ack + auto-expire token within 1 hour. Post-hoc review within 24 hours mandated.

alex: Anything else re: RBAC changes? I think we need two new roles: export-runner (can kick exports) and export-unwrapper (only usable by gateway). No humans get the export-unwrapper role.

maria: Agree. Also add masking pipeline step for PII fields before export where applicable. For large exports we should provide hashed/equiv identifiers instead of raw PII.

jordan: Example export command for infra automation: ```
# kick a 7-day encrypted export
redwood-logs export --query "trace.env=prod AND event.type=auth" --since 7d \
  --encrypt-key projects/redwood/keys/siem-export-2026 --ticket $TICKET_ID --ttl 7d
```

alex: Nice. Follow-ups: - design the gateway (authz checks + KMS unwrap) - draft RBAC changes and key policy - update runbook for oncall unwrap bypass - compliance sign-off template for auditor requests

karen: I'll draft the compliance checklist and approval template, will share tomorrow.

sec-bot: Incident-1234 created: export-request by alex waiting for approval. Ticket: https://tickets/redwood/1234

maria: I'll spin up a quick POC of the gateway and key policy friday. Will post a short demo video.

alex: Great — if folks can +1 the high-level flow we can convert to a RFC and start IAM changes next week. :thumbsup:

jordan: +1

karen: +1

maria: +1
